translations.english: The mountain was as though decorated with mineral rocks of varied colours like blue, red, yellow and green as well as black and white৷৷It was frequently visited by yakshas, kinneras, gandharvas and nagas surrounded by their retinue, capable of assuming any form at their free will rivalling gods and nagas in splendour.
translations.hindi: ग्रतएव हे पवतोत्तम ! म॑ तुमसे कहता हूँ झि, तुम उठो । देखो ये बलवान हनुमान तुम्हारे ऊपर पहुंचना ही चाहते हैं
